title: Headwaters source record
description: One open data source, described well enough that an agent with a shell can start using it without a browser.

publisher.description: Who actually publishes it, not who mirrors it

description.description: What is in it and what it is good for. Written for someone who has never heard of it.

start.description: earliest data, year or ISO date

grain.description: observation cadence: daily, hourly, per-event, snapshot

updated.description: how often the publisher refreshes it

name.description: Exact string. 'unclear' is an acceptable and useful answer.

redistribution.description: What you may republish. Say so plainly if it has not been checked.

bulk.description: Can you get the whole thing, or only query it row by row?

rate_limit.description: Documented limit, and the observed one if they differ

etiquette.description: What a polite client does. Read this before writing a loop.

probes.description: Small, cheap, real requests that prove the source still answers. Run by src/probe.py.

range_bytes.description: Read at most this many bytes. Keeps a probe of a 66 MB file cheap.

min_interval_s.description: Seconds the publisher demands between requests. The prober waits this long before firing.

body_contains.description: Every string must appear in the bytes read

note.description: Context shown beside the probe result - why it is expensive, or why it fails intermittently.

known_broken.description: Set when the probe is expected to fail. The failure is the finding; the note says what it means.

recipes.description: Copy-paste starting points. Should run as written.

gotchas.description: The things that cost someone an hour. The most valuable field in this file.

fields.description: Notable columns/keys worth knowing before you fetch

used_by.description: Quick Projects slugs that consumed this

verified.description: Last day a human or agent read this record and believed it. Probes run more often than this.

status.description: closed = it used to work and no longer does; keep the record, it saves the next person the search
